about: Veridact verifier conformance vectors for specification v0.1 plus the v0.2 proposals in docs/proposals/0.2-verifier-gaps.md. Every case runs at 'now', with 'nonce' issued by the relying party and unused. 'code' is normative; 'reason' is the reference library's internal code and is informative.
